subject: Math
prompt:
A contractor is building a rectangular patio. The length of the patio is to be $7$ feet longer than the width. If the area of the patio will be $144$ square feet, what will be the length, in feet, of the patio?

$$0$$

$$16$$
explanation: The correct answer is $16$. Let $w$ represent the width of the rectangular patio, in feet. Since the length of the patio will be $7$ feet longer than the width, the length will be $w + 7$ feet. Thus the area of the patio will be $w(w + 7)$. It is also given that the area will be $144$ square feet. Therefore, $w(w + 7) = 144$, which is equivalent to $w^{2} + 7w - 144 = 0$. Factoring gives $(w + 16)(w - 9) = 0$, so $w = -16$ or $w = 9$. Because width cannot be negative, the width must be $9$ feet. Therefore, the length of the patio must be $9 + 7 = 16$ feet.
